messages:
lucy: quick flag  i noticed the /v1/classify endpoint examples still use `labels: string[]` in the request body, but our OpenAPI schema expects `labels` to be an array of objects with `id` and `name`. staging docs linted fail.

omar: can you paste the failing snippet? i'll update the examples.

lucy: failing snippet from docs/classify.md:

```json
{
  "input": "Is this safe for work?",
  "labels": ["safety", "policy"]
}
```

paul: ah right, we updated labels to support per-label metadata. canonical shape is:

```json
{
  "input": "Is this safe for work?",
  "labels": [
    {"id": "lbl1", "name": "safety"},
    {"id": "lbl2", "name": "policy"}
  ]
}
```

jen: SDKs accept the old string list for compatibility, but docs should show objects and a tiny migration helper. suggest adding a one-liner for python: `labels = [{"id": str(i), "name": n} for i, n in enumerate(label_names)]`.

lucy: thanks. also line up the Ruby and Go snippets; both still construct `labels = ["..."]`.

ci-bot: docs lint failed: docs/classify.md: example-schema-mismatch (line 31).

omar: opening PR with changes: replace string-array examples with object-array forms, add migration one-liners for py/js/go, and include a short rationale paragraph: "ids preserve label identity for audits and allow metadata like `confidence_threshold`." PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1023

paul: adding tests: examples/fixtures/classify_example.json and a unit to validate against OpenAPI. will push shortly.

jen: suggested wording tweak to make the migration note terse: "If you have legacy string labels, map them to objects with stable ids (index or UUID)." left an inline comment on the PR.

omar: addressed wording and pushed tests. CI run started.

ci-bot: PR checks: lint  pending, schema-tests  pending.

docs-bot: added tag `docs-pr` and assigned reviewers @jen and @paul.

ci-bot: PR checks: lint \u2705, schema-tests \u2705, staging build \u2705.

jen: approved with small nit on phrasing; i corrected and pushed.

paul: double-checked the Go snippet and updated the example to use `labels := []Label{{ID: "0", Name: "safety"}}` style so it compiles.

omar: merged. :tada: i'll add a changelog bullet and a short note in the migration guide.

lucy: awesome, thanks everyone. small doc drift but glad linter caught it before customers saw ambiguous examples. :+1:
